full_judgment: 2. The petitioners as plaintiffs instituted aforementioned suit for partition of ejmali property. Their case was that the land in 'Ka' schedule belonged to Ajim Mondal and that he also purchased the 'Kha' schedule land in the benami of his two sons and they inherited the schedule lands. It was also claimed by plaintiffs that 'Ga' schedule land belonged to Sohagi Bibi a daughter of said Ajimuddin who got the same from her husband and after her death the property devolved upon her 4 nephews Emajuddin defendant No. 1 Basor Mondal, Yonus Mondal plaintiff Nos. 1-2 and Safetulla Mondal. After the death of Safetullah his wife defendant No. 16, 3 sons the plaintiffs No. 9-11 and 4 daughters the plaintiffs No. 12-15 became the owners and they were in ejmali possession of the suit land. The plaintiffs claim 702/728 danti in 'Ka' schedule and 'Kha' schedule land and 12 annas shares in 'Ga' schedule land and prayed for saham to that extent. The defendant Nos. 1-33 contested the suit stating, inter alia, that Ajim Mondal had 4 sons and one daughter; his one son Khabir Uddin Mondal predeceased his father Ajim Mondal leaving behind 2 sons Gudar Mondal and Basor Mondal and one daughter Aku Bibi. Ajim Mondal by an unregistered deed of Vassyatnama disposed of his entire property in favour of his sons, daughter and grandsons and granddaughter and accordingly 21 bighas of land of khatian No. 640 of Ajimatpur mouza was given to his daughter Sohagi Bibi, 2 bigas of land of plot No. 252 of 'Ka' schedule to his sons Ziar Uddin Mondal and 53 decimals of land of plot No. 895 in 'ka' schedule was given to Sohagi Bibi and grand daughter Sefeda Bibi and 3 bighas land to Momtaz Sheikh the foster child of Nasir Uddin, and the rest of the property equally distributed to 3 sons and the grand sons, each sons having 1/4 share and 2 grand sons got 1/4 share and after the death of testator Ajim Mondal all the co-sharers exercised the right of ownership pursuant to the said vassyatnama and possessed their respective share separately and thereafter some of the co-sharers transferred their share of the land to some other persons, records of right have been prepared separately in the name of the co-sharer. The trial Court, the learned Subordinate Judge decreed the suit awarding saham to the plaintiffs partly in the 'Ka' and 'Kha' schedules and 12 annas saham in the 'Ga' schedule lands as claimed by the plaintiffs. In appeal the Additional District Judge, Nawabganj upheld the decree of the trial court but modified the saham of the plaintiffs so far as it relates to 'Ga' schedule property and instead giving 12 annas share in the 'Ga' schedule land to the plaintiffs, the saham of 8 annas was allotted to the plaintiffs. The plaintiffs filed the revisional application before the High Court Division and obtained Rule against the modified decree.
